title: How to Navigate the First 90 Days of a New Job
description:
In this class, we're going to talk about the first 90 days in your new role. Starting a new position can be overwhelming—but it’s also an important time to ensure you’re making the right impressions. 

Here’s a high-level understanding of what we're going to cover in this class:

1. Teal’s approach to the first 90 days and a broader context of how we’re thinking about this critical time.
2. Before you start a new job, some of the work you should do to get going. 
3. The first 90 days themselves and the kind of things you're going to do in that time.
4. Your personal brand and making sure that you don't keep paying attention to it in the same way that you were during the job search. 
5. How to set yourself up for continual career growth past those first 90 days.
